title: paeonia foemina var. humilis
intro: Paeonia foemina var. humilis, commonly known as Wild Peony, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the Paeoniaceae family. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of coughs, colds, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Paeonia foemina var. humilis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects. The plant's therapeutic actions also include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety and stress, and promote relaxation, making it a popular ingredient in traditional herbal remedies.
